description: A wave terrain oscillator: a curve is walked around a landscape built from up to four terrain formulas, and the height under the curve is the sound

params.text: Picks one of the 27 terrain formulas, or NONE; the four are laid over each other to make the landscape
Moves the curve across the terrain, -20 to 20
Moves the curve up the terrain, -20 to 20
Sets how wide the curve is drawn, 0 to 4; a smaller curve covers less terrain and gives a duller sound
Sets how tall the curve is drawn, 0 to 4
Turns the curve about its centre, 0 to a full turn
Shapes the chosen curve, -2 to 4; what it changes depends on which curve is chosen
Picks the shape of the curve: Ellipse, Lemniskate, Limacon, Cornoid, Trisec, Scarabeus, Folium, Talbot, Lissajous, Hypocycloid or Rect
Sets how much of the terrain is drawn on the display, 0.1 to 10; this changes the picture and not the sound
Attenuates the voltage at the Modulation X jack before it is added to the X knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Attenuates the voltage at the Modulation Y jack before it is added to the Y knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Attenuates the voltage at the Modulation Scale X jack before it is added to the RX knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Attenuates the voltage at the Modulation Scale Y jack before it is added to the RY knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Attenuates the voltage at the Modulation Rotation jack before it is added to the ROT knob, 0 to 100 per cent
Attenuates the voltage at the Modulation Curve Parameter jack before it is added to the CP knob, 0 to 100 per cent
While on, a voice sounds only while its channel of the Gate jack is high; while off, the module sounds all the time
Puts the view back over the middle of the terrain, without moving the curve

inputs.text: Sets the pitch, 1V per octave, one channel per voice
Opens the voice of each channel while the Gate button beside it is on; with that button off the module sounds whatever is patched here
Modulates that movement, one per volt scaled by the knob beside it
Modulates that movement, one per volt scaled by the knob beside it
Modulates the width, one per volt scaled by the knob beside it
Modulates the height, one per volt scaled by the knob beside it
Modulates that turning, one radian per volt scaled by the knob beside it
Picks the curve by voltage, one volt per shape over 0-10V, and moves the knob while it is patched
Modulates that shaping, one per volt scaled by the knob beside it
While a cable is patched here the curve is walked by this phase over -5V to 5V and the pitch jack is passed over

outputs.text: The height under the curve as it is walked one way round, -5V to 5V
The height under the curve as it is walked the other way round, which gives a second, related signal for the right channel

notes: drag the blue circle on the display to move the curve, which is the X and Y knobs; drag anywhere else to move the view, which changes nothing in the sound
there is no anti-aliasing at all, so a curve drawn large over a rough terrain aliases badly; scale the curve down to cut the high frequencies
the four terrain knobs are set by right-clicking each one and picking from the list, and NONE leaves that layer out
menu: Block DC — takes the constant offset out of both outputs
